name: desire to protect
description: Wanting to help another even with the potential of a significant cost to the self.

variations.name: protecting romantic love
variations.description: Showing commitment to the relationship with a selfless act or promise.

variations.name: protecting family members
variations.description: Supporting the welfare of kids, parents, or other close family with a personal cost. This may be driven in part by a desire to live up to perceived responsibilities.

variations.name: protect the group
variations.description: Being ready to make a sacrifice for an important social group. Military service would be a prime example. On a smaller scale it could mean quitting your job to become the much-needed coach of a kids team.

variations.name: protect nature
variations.description: Being ready to rescue yet-another-pet from the shelter, or participating in a neighborhood cleanup.

conditions: Perception that action is needed to preserve the comfort or existence of another agent or group despite a risk of personal cost.
